metadata.title: Toric Richardson Varieties and Slice Links
metadata.abstract: For type $A$ braid varieties, including Richardson varieties and positroid varieties, we prove that the standard torus has a dense orbit exactly when the associated link is smoothly slice. More generally, we relate the smooth slice genus to the codimension of a generic standard-torus orbit. For knots, this codimension equals twice the slice genus. We also characterize algebraic tori among open affine Richardson varieties and positroid patches by 2-crown avoidance in their Bruhat intervals. Finally, positroid links have equal Seifert and slice genera, so a positroid link is smoothly slice exactly when it is an unlink.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 环面轨道与切片链环对应
analysis.workSummary: 对 A 型 braid varieties 证明标准环面有稠密轨道当且仅当关联链环光滑切片；对结，泛型轨道余维等于切片亏格的两倍，并以 Bruhat 区间的 2-crown 避免性刻画特定代数环面。
analysis.breakthrough: 把代数群轨道维数与四维光滑切片性质建立精确联系。
analysis.limitations: 结的两倍公式与一般链环的关系需区分；positroid 链环切片等价 unlink 是特定子类结论。
analysis.priorityReason: 把代数群轨道维数与四维光滑切片性质建立精确联系。
